title: 风是怎么吹起来的
subtitle: 空气也会搬家
character: wearing a pale blue t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in long-scroll ink wash style, soft grey-blue washes with fine brush lines, wide open composition, plenty of pale empty paper, calm and airy

pages.zh:
院子里的树叶
忽然都朝一个方向倒。
我的头发也被吹乱了。
可是我什么都没看见。
风到底是什么呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands outdoors with his hair blown to one side, holding his arms slightly out, looking up.

pages.zh:
风就是流动的空气，
也叫「气流」。
空气看不见，
可是它有重量，
会从一个地方搬到另一个地方。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one wide arrow made of several parallel curved lines sweeping from left to right across a pale background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
太阳晒到地面，
地面就变热。
靠近地面的空气也变热，
热空气比较轻，
就往上升。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one flat ground line along the bottom of a pale background with three arrows rising straight up from it, and a sun above at one side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
热空气升上去以后，
下面就空出来了。
旁边的冷空气赶紧补进来。
这一进一出，
就是风。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one ground line on a pale background: three arrows rising in the middle, and two arrows coming in horizontally from the left and right to fill the gap. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以海边常常有风。
白天陆地热得快，
风就从海上吹向陆地；
晚上反过来，
从陆地吹向海。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two panels side by side on a pale background: in the left one an arrow points from the sea toward the land, in the right one an arrow points from the land toward the sea. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
风有大有小。
树叶轻轻动，是微风；
树枝摇起来，风就大了；
整棵树都弯下腰，
那是很大的风。
pages.scene: Three trees in a row on a pale background: the first with only its leaves stirring, the second with branches bending, the third bent right over. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
风是有方向的。
我们说「北风」，
意思是风从北边吹过来，
不是吹向北边。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one compass rose on a pale background with a single bold arrow entering from the north side and pointing toward the centre. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
风能帮我们做事。
它推着帆船走，
转动风车发电，
还把种子带到很远的地方。
pages.scene: Three small pictures in a row on a pale background: a sailing boat, a wind turbine, and a dandelion seed drifting. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
风也会变得很凶。
台风就是又急又转的大风。
遇到台风要待在屋里，
关好窗户，
不要靠近大树和广告牌。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one spiral of curved lines on a pale background, wound tightly in the middle and wider at the edge, with one small closed house beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
怎么知道风往哪吹呢？
抬头看看旗子，
或者把手打湿举起来，
哪一面先觉得凉，
风就从那边来。
pages.scene: One flag on a pole on a pale background, stretched straight out to one side by the wind. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
风一直都在。
就算你站着不动，
它也在你身边
悄悄地走来走去。
只是有时候太轻，感觉不到。
pages.scene: One wide open field on a pale background with tall grass all leaning gently in the same direction. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把手打湿，
高高举起来。
左边先凉了。
原来今天的风，
是从左边来的。
pages.scene: The little boy stands outdoors holding one wet hand up high, eyes closed, feeling which side is cooler.
